summary: Two units (count_text, main) are precisely specified with contracts, errors and boundaries. Unit tests cover normal, boundary and abnormal cases with concrete expected values. System tests TEST-013..018 drive the CLI via subprocess and cover every acceptance criterion (AC-001-1..4, AC-002-1, AC-003-1).

checklist.note: Signatures and line-count rule are unambiguous.
TypeError for non-str, SystemExit 2 for invalid CLI, boundaries listed.
Exact tuples, exact stdout/stderr strings, Korean path case, error cases.

checklist.item: System specs cover every acceptance criterion, black box
checklist.note: All six ACs mapped; procedures run python -m textcli; expected are observable stdout/stderr/exit code.

checklist.item: Nothing designed that no requirement asks for

checklist.note: Single component, interfaces empty; boundary is external CLI covered by system tests.

findings.description: REQ-004 (stdlib only, single component) is a constraint with no dedicated test; it is satisfied by design and verified by review.

integration_applicability.reason: One component with no interfaces; its only boundary is the external CLI, verified by G7 system tests.
